item.title: NHTSA says faulty battery modules in VW ID.4s could pose fire risk
item.description: Volkswagen is recalling nearly 44,000 ID.4 SUVs from 2023–2025 after battery issues linked to overheating and rare fire risks, the NHTSA says.

item.title: Car rams into Chabad headquarters in New York City
item.description: A man was arrested after repeatedly crashing his car into the Chabad Lubavitch world headquarters in New York City on Wednesday night while people were gathered for prayer.

item.title: Gerber recalls snack food over possible contamination
item.description: Gerber is voluntarily recalling certain batches of its Arrowroot Biscuits because of concerns that certain packages may contain “soft plastic and/or paper pieces."

item.title: Sweethearts candy adds sayings like 'split rent' and 'share login' for Valentine's Day
item.description: Nothing says "I love you" like sharing a streaming login or splitting rent. Spangler's Sweethearts conversation hearts are getting a 2026 makeover with sayings that reflect today's economic realities.

item.title: Couple donates record $120M to UC Davis vet school that once cared for their dog
item.description: A philanthropic couple donated $120 million to UC Davis to support its veterinary school, where their dog, Angel, once received care -- the largest gift ever made to veterinary medicine worldwide.

item.title: Faith leaders from across the country unite in Minneapolis to protest ICE operations
item.description: Amid the Trump administration's ongoing deportation campaign in Minnesota, clergy from across the country descended upon Minneapolis to protest in solidarity and support local communities.

item.title: How clean is airline water? New study grades major US carriers
item.description: A new study shows wide differences in airline drinking water safety, with some carriers getting failing grades and experts advising passengers to avoid onboard water not in sealed bottles.

item.title: Huge range of branded foods recalled for rodent contamination, including Cheerios and Tylenol
item.description: A huge range of popular brand-name products from food to pharmaceuticals, including Cheerios and Tylenol, were recalled last month due to potential salmonella contamination.

item.title: Why this year’s Valentine’s Day could be the most expensive love story yet
item.description: Americans will spend a record $29.1B this Valentine’s Day — and some of that love (and cash) is going to friends, co-workers and even pets.

item.title: Chicken wings are cheaper, but other Super Bowl snacks cost more this year
item.description: Americans are expected to eat nearly 1.5 billion chicken wings during the Super Bowl, about 10 million more than last year, according to the National Chicken Council.
